prerequisite: Security-operation readiness and available compute must both be established before resuming the fixed native Clean gate; credible native Clean capability is required before any task-harm panel.

conditional_construction.operation: Keep the fixed observation and candidate actions. Change only diffusion-initialization noise from independent across candidate rows to a shared full tensor across rows. Draw fresh tensors for each generation chunk and each CEM query.
conditional_construction.untouched: Goal encoding, every candidate observation-VAE sample, context-stabilization samples, CPU CEM proposal randomness, model weights, objective and real dynamics.
conditional_construction.full_trajectory_argument: For a fixed query and candidate i, write Y_i=F_i(O,A_i,V_i,C_i,Z_i1,Z_i2,E_i), where V is observation-VAE randomness, C is context stabilization and E includes the remaining native draws. The independent and shared conditions assign the same full within-candidate random-tape distribution; Z_1 and Z_2 remain fresh independent tensors. Thus each complete Y_i marginal is unchanged under the ideal sampler construction. The joint law across i changes. This is a structural argument, not an executed implementation proof.
conditional_construction.excluded_shortcuts: Do not reuse one scalar across time/channel/space or one noise tensor across the two autoregressive chunks or across queries. Do not replace posterior.sample with posterior.mode. Fixed per-candidate marginal moments alone do not establish the full-trajectory claim.
conditional_construction.batch_separability_assumption: The pushforward argument assumes native per-candidate execution does not mix candidate rows. The inspected NanoWM tensor axes support this assumption; a future adapter must preserve it and check implementation behavior before claiming an executed law-preservation result.

implementation_confounds_to_control: Native H5 produces two generation chunks. Coupling would need a query/chunk identity spanning the seven native microbatches; independent per-microbatch sharing is a different specified joint law.
Separate the CPU action-proposal stream, planner-private goal VAE stream, candidate observation-VAE stream, context-noise stream and selected initial-diffusion stream.
Eta zero still consumes randn_like draws in DDIM. Even unused noise can shift later global randomness, so equal outputs at one site are not enough to establish matched conditions.

A frozen candidate query can use identical candidates; full native CEM trajectories will generally acquire different later candidate sets as a consequence of prior selections. Do not describe adaptive end-to-end CEM as an everywhere-fixed-candidate test.
permission_boundary: The native rollout interface has no caller noise argument. A researcher-added sampler hook with cross-candidate control is an explicit additional supply-chain permission; it is not a discovered public deployment interface, legal-action-only manipulation, or a process isolation guarantee.
potential_controls: Independent sampling versus shared sampling, with identical model call/particle/horizon/optimizer budgets. Restoring trusted independent sampling is a permission-removal control, not a certified defense if the compromised provider can ignore client seeds. Extra samples or bank-mean aggregation cannot be silently counted as same-budget recovery.

native_decision_boundary.finding: CEM executes the final elite-action mean, not the best individual candidate or the first iteration ranking.
native_decision_boundary.current_cache_limit: The prepared Clean adapter would save RNG, returned actions and loss history, not every candidate or final forecast bank. Both attempted Clean runs are terminal before model/task execution; no cached native final-query counterfactual is available.
native_decision_boundary.minimum_evidence_if_revisited: Use an explicitly captured fixed final CEM query or a clearly labeled added decision experiment; evaluate the actual selected mean action sequence through matched real-environment replay. Ranking changes alone do not establish utility loss.

primary_prior_art.title: Using Common Random Numbers for Simulation-based Planning with Rollouts
primary_prior_art.verified_scope: Primary HTML abstract, Section1.2 including Proposition1 and its proof, Section2 statement and assumptions of Theorem2; not a full empirical reproduction.
primary_prior_art.finding: The paper explicitly gives cases where dependent sampling increases relative-value variance, and a depth-based construction with a variance guarantee under a shared-tail policy assumption. Therefore a generic claim that coupling changes action-comparison uncertainty is prior art.
primary_prior_art.limit: Its shared-tail transition-sampling theorem is not automatically a guarantee for this diffusion-video CEM interface. A shared-noise condition can improve or harm planning; no direction or malicious selection ability is established here.

decision: Keep this as conditional sampler-sensitivity feasibility only. Do not automatically resume expensive Clean from GPU availability alone; see the subsequent root security-readiness decision. No intervention or task outcome is established.
